title: The Haunted Hall of Mirrors
blurb: Reflections have stepped out of the mirrors and are swapping places with fairgoers. Put everyone back the right way round!

hooks.title: Who Waved First?
text: {hero} waves at a funhouse mirror.
The reflection waves back... a whole second later.

choices.label: Wave again, slowly
choices.text: The reflection copies badly. It is not a reflection at all!

choices.label: Ask {ally}
choices.text: {ally} gasps: {villain} has let the reflections out!

hooks.title: Backwards Day
text: Fairgoers walk out of the mirror hall backwards.
Their hats are on their feet. Their socks are on their ears.

choices.label: Charge into the hall!
choices.text: Everyone marches in. Every mirror turns to stare.

choices.label: Polish a mirror
choices.text: {hero} rubs a mirror clean. Now it shows only the truth!

deed.text: polished a mirror until it told the truth

beats.title: Funny Faces
text: Six reflections are pulling faces at the crowd.
Nobody can tell which faces are the real ones.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so you know to watch for slow copycats.

choices.label: Pull a sillier face
choices.text: Everyone scrunches up their best silly face.

game.intro: Copy the faces faster than the mirrors!

win.text: {winner} pulls a face so silly a reflection laughs and pops back in.

lose.text: {loser}'s face gets stuck for a moment. Everyone giggles.

deed.text: got a funny face stuck for a minute

choices.label: Spot the real ones
choices.text: {hero} squints. Real faces blink. Reflections forget to.

win.text: {winner} points out every fake. They sulk back into the glass.

lose.text: {loser} points at their own reflection. It points back.

beats.title: The Wobbly Room
text: In the Wobbly Room, every mirror makes you tall or wide.
A stretchy reflection is bouncing off the walls!

choices.label: Bounce after it
choices.text: {hero} boings off the springy floor.

win.text: {winner} catches the stretchy one mid-boing and pops it home.

lose.text: {loser} looks three metres tall for a while. Nice view!

choices.label: Tilt the mirrors
choices.text: {hero} turns the mirrors so they all face one corner.

game.intro: Bounce the light into the corner!

win.text: {winner} traps it in a beam of light. It sighs and steps back in.

deed.text: trapped a reflection with a beam of light

lose.text: {loser} shines the light right into their own eyes. Sparkly!

beats.title: The Glass Garden
text: Glass flowers chime in {place}.
A reflection is picking them all for {villain}.

choices.label: Catch it red-handed
choices.text: Everyone tiptoes in a line through the chiming flowers.

game.intro: Do not make a single chime!

win.text: {winner} taps it on the shoulder. Caught! Back in the mirror it goes.

lose.text: {loser} sneezes. Every flower rings like a bell.

choices.label: Plant them back
choices.text: {hero} kneels down and starts replanting the flowers.

game.intro: Put the flowers back in bloom!

win.text: {winner} plants the last flower. The reflection is so touched it goes home.

lose.text: {loser} plants a flower upside down. It chimes a little tune anyway.

deed.text: planted a glass flower upside down

beats.title: Double Trouble
text: A second {hero} walks out of a mirror, grinning.
Now there are two. Which one is real?

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. That mirror is about to help.

choices.label: Ask a tricky question
choices.text: "What did you have for breakfast?" Both say "toast".

game.intro: Find out which one is fibbing!

win.text: {winner} asks about socks. The fake one has no idea. Back you go!

lose.text: {loser} asks the real one by mistake. Very awkward hug.

choices.label: Race them both
choices.text: Reflections run backwards. That is the trick!

win.text: {winner} spots the one running backwards and tags it out.

lose.text: {loser} tries running backwards too and bumps into a bin.

choices.label: Hold up the true mirror
choices.text: {hero} holds up the polished mirror. One twin has no reflection!

game.intro: Flash the true mirror at the fake!

win.text: {winner} flashes the mirror. The fake twin squeaks and vanishes home.

deed.text: showed a fake twin the truth

lose.text: {loser} flashes the mirror at a passing goose. It honks.

beats.title: The Candle Maze
text: A maze of mirrors, lit by one little candle.
A hundred candles flicker back. Which way is out?

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}, so this maze holds no fear.

choices.label: Follow the real flame
choices.text: {hero} holds the candle up high.

win.text: {winner} finds the way out, and a reflection hiding in a dead end.

deed.text: found the way through the candle maze

lose.text: {loser} walks into a mirror and says sorry to it.

choices.label: Feel along the walls
choices.text: Everyone holds hands and shuffles forward in a line.

win.text: {winner} gathers the most candles. Suddenly the maze is bright!

deed.text: lit up the whole candle maze

lose.text: {loser} grabs a candle that turns out to be a carrot.

beats.title: The Reflection Parade
text: A parade of reflections dances down the midway.
They are copying everyone's dance moves. Badly.

choices.label: Out-dance them!
choices.text: Everyone starts a wild wiggle.

win.text: {winner}'s moves are too fancy to copy. Three reflections give up and go home.

deed.text: won the dance-off with the reflections

lose.text: {loser} invents a brand-new dance called The Flop.

deed.text: invented a dance called The Flop

choices.label: Lead them home
choices.text: {hero} starts a conga line toward the mirror hall.

win.text: {winner} conga-dances every reflection back into its frame.

deed.text: led a conga line of reflections home

lose.text: {loser} ends up at the back of the conga, facing the wrong way.

beats.title: The Whispering Glass
text: A tall mirror whispers secrets about {villain}.
"I know where the Marquis keeps the key..."

choices.label: Answer its riddle
choices.text: "What has a face but never smiles?" {hero} thinks hard.

win.text: {winner} answers: a clock! The mirror hands over a tiny glass key.

lose.text: {loser} answers "a potato". The mirror laughs for a full minute.

deed.text: made a mirror laugh with a potato

choices.label: Tell it a secret back
choices.text: Everyone leans in and whispers their best secret.

win.text: {winner}'s secret is so lovely the mirror gives up the glass key.

deed.text: swapped secrets with a magic mirror

lose.text: {loser} admits they still sleep with a teddy. The mirror says "aww".

deed.text: told a mirror about their teddy

beats.title: The Portrait Gallery
text: Painted portraits of {villain} line the walls.
Their eyes follow you. One portrait winks.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. These painted eyes do not scare you.

extra.text: The tiny glass key fits a frame. It swings open!

choices.label: Paint some moustaches
choices.text: Everyone grabs a paintbrush. Hee hee.

win.text: {winner}'s curly moustache is the best. The portrait giggles and drops a clue.

lose.text: {loser} paints a moustache on their own face instead.

choices.label: Find the odd one out
choices.text: {hero} walks the gallery slowly, looking at every frame.

win.text: {winner} spots the portrait that moved. Behind it: a secret door!

deed.text: found the secret door in the gallery

lose.text: {loser} stares at a portrait so long it looks away first.

deed.text: won a staring contest with a painting

beats.title: The Shiny Bridge
text: A bridge of mirror tiles stretches over a ball pit.
Some tiles are only reflections of tiles.

callbacks.text: Since {who} {deed}, you can tell real tiles from fake.

choices.label: Hop across
choices.text: {hero} takes a big breath and hops onto the first tile.

game.intro: Only step on the real tiles!

win.text: {winner} hops across without a single plop.

lose.text: {loser} plops into the ball pit and comes up wearing balls like a hat.

deed.text: swam in the ball pit by mistake

choices.label: Roll a marble first
choices.text: {hero} rolls a marble. It drops through the fake tiles!

win.text: {winner} maps every safe tile. Everyone strolls across.

lose.text: {loser} rolls a marble into {ally}'s pocket.

beats.title: The Mirror Ballroom
text: A giant mirror ball spins over an empty ballroom.
Every sparkle is a tiny reflection, waltzing.

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. The sparkles want to dance with you!

extra.text: A glass flower in your pocket chimes: they like you.

choices.label: Join the waltz
choices.text: Everyone bows and takes a sparkle by the hand.

win.text: {winner} waltzes so well the sparkles float home happy.

lose.text: {loser} steps on a sparkle's toes. It says it is fine.

choices.label: Stop the mirror ball
choices.text: {hero} reaches for the rope that spins the ball.

win.text: {winner} stops the ball. Every sparkle zips home in one big flash.

lose.text: {loser} spins round with the ball and gets very dizzy.

deed.text: spun around under the mirror ball

interludes.title: A Sparkly Shard
text: A tiny mirror shard twinkles on the floor.
It shows a sunny day, even though it is night.

choices.label: Keep it for luck
choices.text: {hero} tucks the shard away. It feels warm, like sunshine.

deed.text: found a shard full of sunshine

choices.label: Give it away
choices.text: {ally} beams. "This will fix my favourite mirror!"

any: "I did not run away! Can I help?"
A small shy reflection peeks out of a spoon.

choices.label: Welcome aboard!
choices.text: The reflection joins the party, copying everyone's smiles.

deed.text: made friends with a kind reflection

choices.label: Play copy-cat
choices.text: {hero} hops on one leg. The reflection hops too. Best game ever.

climax.title: The Marquis Steps Out
text: {villain} steps out of the biggest mirror of all.
"Everyone should look like ME! Starting now!"

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. No trick can fool you now.

extra.text: Your friendly reflection stands right beside you.

choices.label: Face it together
choices.text: Everyone stands shoulder to shoulder. No more swapping!

text: {villain} trips on a cape and tumbles into the glass!
{prize} is yours!

lose.text: {villain} slips away through a mirror, still admiring that hair.

choices.label: Challenge to a pose-off
choices.text: {hero} strikes a pose. {villain} cannot resist a contest.

win.text: {winner}'s pose is so grand {villain} faints, and drops {prize}.

lose.text: {loser} poses like a teapot. It is honestly quite good.

climax.title: The Last Reflection
text: {villain} holds up {prize} and laughs.
"One look in this, and you will all be MY reflections!"

callbacks.text: {who} {deed}. Light and truth are on your side.

extra.text: You sneak in through the secret door. Surprise!

choices.label: Bounce the light back
choices.text: Everyone grabs a mirror and aims it at {villain}.

text: The magic bounces back! {villain} turns into a statue.
{prize} is safe!

lose.text: Too slow! {villain} vanishes in a puff of glitter.

choices.label: Grab the mirror!
choices.text: {hero} shuts both eyes tight and dives for {prize}.

win.text: {winner} snatches {prize}! Every reflection zips home at once.

lose.text: {loser} grabs a hairbrush instead. Still, very shiny.

any: Every reflection is back where it belongs.
{villain} now polishes mirrors and smiles at other people.
The hall of mirrors shines like new.
And everyone's socks are back on their feet.
Most reflections are home, but {villain} kept {prize}.
Wave at a mirror. If it waves late... watch out!
{villain} got away into the glass this time.
But the fair is the right way round again!

lines.text: The sunny shard lights the mirror hall every night now.
The glass garden chimes a thank-you song.
Your friendly reflection still waves on time.
